role: Per-user overnight HRV baseline: keeps one data point per night (max 90) persisted to HRVBaseline.json sealed with the app's key (JSONFileSeal), derives a display baseline over the 7 most recent stored nights (geometric-mean RMSSD etc.) and ln(RMSSD) z-score stats over the last 60 stored nights for recovery scoring, gating which sessions may enter. Also exposes the baseline's night selection as static functions (isBaselineCandidate, baselineRMSSDs) so the daily report's baseline counts exactly the nights the score counts.
types: BaselineTracker: class (@unchecked Sendable, NSRecursiveLock-protected) — baseline store and statistics; the one-per-night merge and its replacement rules are in BaselineTracker+NightReplacement.swift
BaselineTracker.Baseline: struct Codable — display baseline snapshot over the 7 most recent stored nights (minimumSamples=3)
BaselineTracker.BaselineDeviation: struct Codable — per-metric % deviation of a session vs baseline
BaselineTracker.RecoveryBaselineStats: struct — ln(RMSSD) mean/SD/7-night CV + HR mean/SD for z-scores (minimumDays=3)
BaselineTracker.BaselineDataPoint: struct Codable (internal so BaselineTracker+NightReplacement.swift can name it) — one stored night incl. window-quality fields for replacement
BaselineTracker.StoredData: private struct Codable — on-disk wrapper {baseline, historicalData}
BaselineTracker.SaveHold: private enum — fileNotRead | unreadableNotSetAside: why save() must not write over baselineFile
state: file:<baselineFile> — HRVBaseline.json in the App Group container (or Documents) for the app via init(onBaselineUpdated:), any URL via init(baselineFile:onBaselineUpdated:) / init(baselineFile:seal:onBaselineUpdated:) (JSON iso8601 sealed with the seal — the app's key, EncryptionManager; plain JSON written by builds that did not seal it still opens; .atomic + completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication)
file:HRVBaseline.json.corrupt (quarantine copy of an undecodable baseline file)
mem:BaselineTracker.baselineWindowDays (static let 7 — the 7 most recent stored nights for the display baseline and the 7-day CV)
mem:BaselineTracker.onBaselineUpdated (injected (rmssd, hr) closure; production wiring RRCollector.swift:647 → SettingsManager.updateBaseline)
mem:BaselineTracker.recoveryWindowNights (static let 60 — nights the recovery score's baseline reads; also ReportBaselineNights.count and the coach report's night limit)

mem:BaselineTracker.saveHold (private var SaveHold?: .fileNotRead — the file could not be read at load but may be intact (protection-locked or a read that can pass) and is re-read on unlock / become-active / background or before the next change; .unreadableNotSetAside — the file did not decode and the copy of its bytes could not be written aside; save() writes nothing while it is set and the file exists)
mem:BaselineTracker.undecodableBytes (bytes of an undecodable file whose copy aside is not yet written)
mem:BaselineTracker.lastSleepSchedule (schedule of the last update/rebuild, for merging held nights after unlock)

mem:BaselineTracker.unlockObservers (NotificationTokens: protectedDataDidBecomeAvailable + didBecomeActive + didEnterBackground, installed once (observingUnlock) when the file could not be read at load or a save could not be written; removed in deinit)
mem:BaselineTracker.seal (let JSONFileSeal: seals and opens baselineFile; .app for the app, a test seal otherwise)
mem:BaselineTracker.unsavedChanges (private var Bool: the last save failed (no key reachable to seal, or the write), so the file holds the previous save; the unlock observers save again)
mem:BaselineTracker.observingUnlock (private var Bool: the unlock observers are installed)
toplevel: Stored-property initializers: fileManager = FileManager.default, lock = NSRecursiveLock(), historicalData = [], saveHold/undecodableBytes/lastSleepSchedule = nil, unsavedChanges = false, observingUnlock = false, unlockObservers = NotificationTokens(). Class is @unchecked Sendable relying on manual lock discipline. Static constants baselineWindowDays=7, maxHistoricalPoints=90, recoveryWindowNights=60. Imports UIKit for the unlock notifications.

units.does: Convenience init for the app: resolves AppConfig.sharedContainerURL()/HRVBaseline.json, logs the container path, and delegates to init(baselineFile:onBaselineUpdated:).
reads: file:<AppGroup or Documents>/HRVBaseline.json (via the designated init)

units.does: Convenience: a tracker on baselineFile sealed with the app's key — init(baselineFile:seal:onBaselineUpdated:) with JSONFileSeal.app.

Stores the callback, baselineFile and seal, loads stored data (opened with the seal), installs the unlock observers when the file could not be read or its key was locked (hold .fileNotRead), recomputes the display baseline from the stored nights (not trusting the saved one), pushes it to the callback when it has >= 3 nights, and logs counts.
units.entry: Called by init(baselineFile:onBaselineUpdated:) with the app's seal; tests pass a seal they control.

units.does: Returns currentBaseline under the lock (the 7-calendar-day display baseline, may be nil).
True when a currentBaseline exists and its sampleCount >= 3.

branches.effect: returns false; otherwise returns sampleCount >= Baseline.minimumSamples (3)

units.does: Returns the number of stored nights (historicalData.count, max 90), not limited to the 7-day window.
Returns ln(RMSSD) z-score stats over all stored nights (last 60 by count) — the 'show' baseline including tonight.
Returns z-score stats computed only from stored nights whose SleepSchedule.nightKey is strictly earlier than the session's night, so a night is never scored against itself or later nights.
Takes up to the last recoveryWindowNights (60) points, converts to ln(RMSSD), and builds RecoveryBaselineStats; nil below 3 points or 3 positive RMSSD values.

branches.effect: returns nil (no z-score baseline); else continues with suffix(60)

branches.cond: fewer than 3 positive-RMSSD values among the last 60

units.does: Maps points to ln(rmssd), dropping points with rmssd <= 0.
Builds RecoveryBaselineStats: ln-mean, SD = max(widenedLnSD, 0.10 floor), 7-night CV, HR mean and SD floored at 0.5, daysInWindow = count of ln values, lastDataPointDate = last point date.
Sample SD of ln values multiplied by sqrt(7/n) when n < 7 (1.0 at n >= 7), widening small-sample SD; shared by DailyLoopAnalysis and TrendAnalysis+Verdict.

branches.effect: widening = 1.0; else sqrt(7/count) (≈1.53 at 3). Count 0 would give sqrt(7/0)=inf × 0 = NaN, but no caller passes 0: stats(from:) and DailyLoopAnalysis guard >= 3 (DailyLoopAnalysis.swift:225), TrendAnalysis passes its earlier group which is >= 2 (TrendAnalysis+Verdict.swift:52,114)

units.does: Coefficient of variation (×100) of ln(RMSSD) over the 7 most recent stored nights (the same count-based window as the display baseline, baselineWindowDays); nil with < 7 points or < 3 positive values.

branches.cond: fewer than 3 positive RMSSD among last 7
branches.effect: returns nil; else CV×100 (nil if mean ln is 0)

units.does: Filters sessions to complete overnight analysed HRV-reliable ones and sorts oldest-first; then, under one hold of the lock, first records the sleep schedule (lastSleepSchedule) and re-reads a file that could not be read at load (reloadAfterUnlock, merging the nights held in memory onto it), merges each session through merge(_:sleepSchedule:) and, if any was admitted, commits once (sort, trim, recalculate, notify, one file write unless saves are held); logs counts inside the lock.

branches.effect: logs and returns without touching state
file re-read; when readable the held nights are merged onto it and committed

units.does: Rebuild filter: state == .complete, sessionType == .overnight, analysisResult present and isReliableForHRVAggregates.

Static: whether a session can hold a baseline night — isRebuildCandidate (complete, overnight, analyzed, isReliableForHRVAggregates), isStructurallySoundForBaseline on its analysis result, and a measured (not estimated) SDNN: what rebuildFromSessions admits through admitsToBaseline. Used by baselineRMSSDs and by the report night readers (ReportBaselineNights, WorkoutRecorder+Metrics.recentOvernightSessions) to count baseline nights.

branches.cond: not a rebuild candidate or no analysisResult

units.does: Static, lock-free: replays the canonical baseline selection over `sessions` for the night of `session`. Keeps isBaselineCandidate sessions whose nightKey is before the session's night, sorts them by start, builds each one's data point and merges it into its night slot with mergeIntoNight (same replacement rule as the stored baseline), then returns the RMSSD of the last recoveryWindowNights (60) nights, oldest first — the nights recoveryBaselineStats(excludingNightOf:) would read on a tracker rebuilt from the same sessions. Non-positive RMSSDs are returned as is (the caller drops them, as stats(from:) does).

branches.cond: candidate and night before the session's
branches.effect: kept; else dropped (incl. the session's own night and later nights)

units.does: Structural baseline gate: isStructurallySound(result:sessionDuration:) with the session's duration (end ?? start minus start).

branches.effect: duration 0, so the span and 3 h tests fail unless the window is long enough and recovery organized

units.does: True when the analysed span — the window (windowEndMs − windowStartMs) or, with no window, the whole session — is at least forReliableWindowMs (300 s), and either recovery was organized or the session lasted at least forOvernightSessionSeconds (3 h).

branches.effect: span = window length; else span = sessionDuration

units.does: Under the lock: records the sleep schedule (lastSleepSchedule) and re-reads a file that could not be read at load (reloadAfterUnlock), then merge(_:sleepSchedule:) (gate + night slot); when admitted, commitChanges() (sort, trim to 90, recalculate, notify, save unless saves are held).

branches.effect: file re-read; when readable the held nights are merged onto it and committed

branches.cond: merge returns false (no analysisResult or not admitted)

units.does: When the session has an analysisResult and passes admitsToBaseline, merges its data point into its night slot of historicalData (static mergeIntoNight) and returns true; else false. Caller holds the lock.
Sorts historicalData by date, keeps the newest 90 points, recalculates the display baseline, notifies the callback and saves to disk. Caller holds the lock.

branches.effect: keeps only the newest 90 points (oldest dropped permanently)

units.does: Four gates: overnight sessionType, isReliableForHRVAggregates (not .insufficient/.preSleep), isStructurallySoundForBaseline (each logging its rejection), and an SDNN that is not an estimate (a data point's SDNN is a stored number the SDNN baseline averages).
Builds a BaselineDataPoint from the session (start/end dates) and analysis result (time-domain, frequency-domain, DFA, ANS metrics, window quality fields).
Calls onBaselineUpdated(rmssd, meanHR) when currentBaseline has >= 3 samples.
calls: closure:onBaselineUpdated → Emuqu/Sources/Models/SettingsManager.swift:381 (set by RRCollector.swift:647; nil in tests/default init)

branches.effect: returns without calling; the settings copy keeps its previous values

units.does: % deviations of the session's RMSSD, SDNN, HR, HF, LF/HF, stress, readiness from the current display baseline (7 most recent stored nights) via deviation(of:against:); nil without a baseline of >= 3 nights or without analysis. A night already admitted is part of that baseline; deviation(for:sleepSchedule:) excludes it.

branches.effect: returns nil; else deviation(of:against:) (nil below 3 nights)

units.does: % deviations of the session from a display baseline built (makeBaseline) over the 7 most recent stored nights strictly before the session's night (SleepSchedule.nightKey); nil when there is none, it has < 3 nights, or the session has no analysis.

branches.cond: no earlier night or no analysisResult

units.does: BaselineDeviation of result vs baseline (percent per metric); sdnnDeviation nil when the result's SDNN is an estimate; nil overall when baseline.sampleCount < 3.

Clears currentBaseline and historicalData under the lock, lifts a .fileNotRead hold (the unread file's nights are the ones being discarded, so it is written over unread) and saves the empty state; an .unreadableNotSetAside hold stays, so save() writes only once the undecodable bytes are written aside or the file is gone.
Removes the unlock observers from NotificationCenter.default.
Static: mean of values, nil when empty.
Sets currentBaseline to makeBaseline over the 7 most recent stored nights (by count, so a gap in recording does not empty or shrink it); nil when nothing is stored.
Display Baseline over the given points: geometric-mean RMSSD, arithmetic SDNN/HR, optional means of HF/LF/LF-HF/DFA/stress/readiness, sampleCount = point count, date = now; nil for no points.
exp(mean(ln rmssd)) over positive RMSSD values; arithmetic mean when none are positive.

branches.effect: returns arithmetic mean of raw rmssd; else geometric mean

units.does: ((current-baseline)/baseline)*100, nil when baseline <= 0.
Same as percentDeviation for optional inputs; nil if either is nil or baseline <= 0.

branches.cond: current or baseline nil, or baseline <= 0

units.does: If HRVBaseline.json exists and readFile() returns its contents, sets currentBaseline/historicalData; otherwise the tracker stays empty with the hold readFile set.

Reads baselineFile. Read throws: saveHold = hold(forReadError:) — .fileNotRead while the file may be intact (protection-locked or a read that can pass), none when it is gone or can never be read — logged, nil. Read: returns decodeOrSetAside(bytes) (opened with the seal and decoded; nil with .fileNotRead when the key is locked; nil with the bytes that do not open or decode written aside — hold .unreadableNotSetAside when that write fails).

branches.effect: logged as nothing to keep; else logged as waiting

units.does: Whether hold(forReadError:) holds saves for the error — readFile's decision, exposed for tests.
FileReadFailure(error): .locked or .transient → .fileNotRead; .gone or .nothingToKeep → nil.

Opens the bytes with seal (sealed bytes decrypted; plain JSON from builds that did not seal the file passed through) and decodes StoredData (iso8601). When the keychain refuses the key (JSONFileSeal.isKeyLocked): logs, sets saveHold = .fileNotRead (the file is left as it is and re-read after unlock) and returns nil. Any other open or decode error: writes the bytes aside (setAsideUndecodable), logs at .error, sets saveHold = nil when written or .unreadableNotSetAside when not, and returns nil.

branches.cond: open throws with the key locked

branches.effect: bytes written aside → no hold; write failed → .unreadableNotSetAside; nil

units.does: Once (observingUnlock): adds observers (queue nil) for UIApplication.protectedDataDidBecomeAvailable, didBecomeActive and didEnterBackground that call retryAfterUnlock, kept in unlockObservers.
Takes the lock, runs reloadAfterUnlock (a no-op once the .fileNotRead hold is gone), then saves again when the last save failed (unsavedChanges).
units.entry: protectedDataDidBecomeAvailable / didBecomeActive / didEnterBackground observers installed by observeUnlock

units.does: Caller holds lock. Only while saveHold == .fileNotRead: if the file is gone the hold is cleared; else readFile(). Still unreadable: returns with the hold readFile left (still unread → .fileNotRead). Readable: merges every night held in memory onto the file's nights with mergeIntoNight using lastSleepSchedule (none recorded means no nights are held), clears the hold, logs and commitChanges() (sort, trim, recalculate, notify, save).

branches.effect: held nights merged into the file's nights

units.does: Writes the bytes of an undecodable baseline file to HRVBaseline.json.corrupt (atomic, completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication; an earlier copy is replaced only by a complete new one). On success clears undecodableBytes and returns true; on failure keeps the bytes in undecodableBytes for a later retry and returns false (no log; callers log).

Caller holds lock. Whether save() may write baselineFile: true with no hold; with a hold, true (hold and undecodableBytes cleared) when the file is gone or, for .unreadableNotSetAside, when the held bytes are now written aside (logged); otherwise false without logging (the hold was logged when set; a .fileNotRead file waits for reloadAfterUnlock).

branches.cond: file present and not set aside

units.does: Unless mayWriteFile() says no (a held file still on disk), encodes StoredData (pretty-printed, iso8601), seals it with seal and writes it atomically with completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication, clearing unsavedChanges. When encoding, sealing (no key reachable) or the write fails, nothing is written — the file keeps the previous save and the nights are never written in the clear — the failure is logged at .error, unsavedChanges is set and the unlock observers are installed, so the next change or an unlock/activation/background notification saves again. Caller holds lock.

branches.effect: nothing written; logged at .error; unsavedChanges = true; observeUnlock()
